label: Test contingent-foundation exemptions under parity and determining explanation
summary: See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#does-a-contingent-foundation-merit-exemption-from-determining-explanation-2026-11-23. Continuation of #1908; avoids #1909's C2 note and attempt. Distinguishes adequacy-qualified actual local existential reason coverage E (concrete individuals), determining coverage D (possibly joint basis sufficient across the relevant accessible alternatives), and a stance's corresponding demand. The exact classical negations are actual counterinstances to the selected coverage, not universal bruteness; b36104ba additionally denies a distinct esse-cause. The #756 feature parity results constrain same-quality demands, not the truth of E/D. Independently warranted dependence, temporal ordering, constitution, kind-specific laws and necessity can restrict a particular explanatory demand, but a warranted exemption does not by itself determine the exempt contingent individual's actuality. Role/occupant and relocation tests separate reasons for the rule from reasons for the bearer; no admissible alternative is inferred from a formal comparison. Binary recurrence control shows that stipulated primitive initial input need not license arbitrary later values under fixed constraints. Self-application distinguishes evidence for a rule, its obtaining as a contingent fact, and a concrete law-bearer's existence; scope matters at every step. Actual nonnecessitating production can explain its product while leaving a determining contrast about the act open; a distinct actual selector need not copy its output, but merely relocating an unexplained contrast does not complete broader coverage. #755 collapse core is not a consequence of D alone. Provisional moderate preference for E over a brute exception; suspension about universal D, high confidence in conditional adequacy and scope tests. Existing B2 reason-to-esse bridges and same-root results are reused, no new certified proof or premise discharge. Independent semantic challenge and canonical CLI checks pending; no new attribution.
blocker: The universal adequacy reading of E is not established by the existing token-level local PSR, and receipt examples do not establish coverage of an underived simple individual. D requires further warrant that nonnecessitating existential production cannot be complete; a principled derivative-only restricted policy is a standing rival. Next compare the same-bearer actual exercise and its own contingent explanandum in the existing productive/agency framework, checking the joint determining basis and whether a reason for its obtaining is required at the selected scope. Local CLI, installed convention inspection and independent review are unavailable in this connector-only session; keep as unreviewed research checkpoint.
